chunks: Also, Ali (peace be upon him) said: The bed of the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) was a cloak. His cushion was leather, its filling was palm fibre. I folded it for him one night, and when morning came, he said: Indeed, the bed has prevented me from the night prayer tonight. So he ordered that it be made into a single layer.

key_terms.الصَّلَاة: Al-Salah -- prayer, specifically the voluntary night prayer (tahajjud/qiyam al-layl)
key_terms.بِطَاق: Bitaq -- a single layer/fold, indicating the Prophet wanted the thinnest possible bed
key_terms.فِرَاش: Firash -- bed or bedding, here referring to the Prophet's extremely simple sleeping arrangement

ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet Muhammad's bed like and why did he prefer simplicity?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) recounts the Prophet Muhammad's austere lifestyle. His bed was merely a cloak and a leather cushion stuffed with palm fibre. When Ali folded the bed to make it thicker one night, the Prophet complained in the morning that the added comfort had kept him from his night prayer (tahajjud). He ordered that the bed be restored to just a single layer, demonstrating his preference for simplicity and devotion over physical comfort.
